'''Regis Michelena''' played the [[2010 US West Nationals]]. On the Players Committee forum he posted as Kizakh, signing his posts "Regis Michelena, Team Wyoming".<ref name="sf-21799-316368">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316368#p316368 Colorado States], Regis Michelena (Kizakh), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192412/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21799.html Internet Archive]</ref> He was the tournament director of the [[2008 Wyoming State Championship]] on 17 August 2008 at Slackers in Laramie, Wyoming, run with a three-judge system,<ref name="sf-21008-303347">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=303347#p303347 Road to Worlds - Western US - All West States Events/Plans], Scott Church (CategoryOneGames.com), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125190718/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21008.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-21799-316368" /> and finished 6th, 4 (-36), of ten players; he also wrote a tournament report on the Colorado and Wyoming State Championships on his blog.<ref name="sf-21794-330547">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=330547#p330547 Wyoming States 2008!], Regis Michelena (Kizakh), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192329/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21794.html Internet Archive]</ref>
